column5: Routed 2026-08-25 at /play/fortune-wheel; was an 896x800 dialog at scale 0.398 - the mildest of the seven and still unusable (SPIN THE WHEEL 127.2x22.3, icon controls 17.5 sq). Measured at 375: scale 1, SPIN 307x56, currency 63x44, bet input 123x44, all controls reachable. The wheel is w-80 (320px) below sm, so it already fitted 375 unscaled - the transform was the only thing shrinking it. ⚠️ CORRECTED 2026-08-26 (was `unknown`): re-verified live against the Figma page, the route table and prod site_config. See status.game-rollups.verified.tsv for the evidence. 2026-08-26 (skai-gaming 41e85aa, NOT DEPLOYED): three decorations no frame draws are gone from the wheel - a from-primary/30 blur-xl halo, 24 pulsing bg-yellow-400 lamps at 48% radius, and a Star at opacity-10 behind the readout - and the pointer is now a FRACTION of the wheel (0.1253 tall, 0.0379 overhang) instead of a fixed 20x50, which was 25% oversized at the 320 wheel a 375 viewport gets. STILL OPEN and a Casey question, not a parity fix: 9733:7556 is a 50-tick ANNULUS (band 0.803..0.892 of the radius, dark centre) where the app draws a full-radius conic pie with a label on every wedge; collapsing to the band leaves no room for the labels and the frame carries none. The multiplier strip 9733:5378 was RE-MEASURED and already matches (179.6x42 equal chips, padX 12, gap 8, radius 8 literal, drop-shadow 0 3px 0 tier, Manrope Bold 14); its only deltas are the 9-vs-5 chip count (rail, permanent) and vertical anchoring.
